statement: Pinned Linux hid-steam input_open/input_close automatically toggle lizard settings only when neither STEAM_QUIRK_DECK nor STEAM_QUIRK_IBEX is set. For the wired 28de:1302 IBEX quirk, evdev input_open and input_close do NOT issue those lizard SET reports. Distinctly, sensor_open/sensor_close may send IMU settings unless client_opened is nonzero, and a Menu hold can schedule mode-switch output. Linux hid-steam.c lines 909-976,2441-2458. Direct-device runtime result: No evidence.
